heading: I'm Peter, a software developer based in the UK.
lead: I build business software, developer tools, games and interactive experiments. I care about making things dependable, understandable and genuinely pleasant to use.
background: My professional background is in automated software testing and framework development. I've worked on the systems behind test automation, including tooling for difficult page structures, tables, iframes and repeatable workflows.

Outside that role, I design and build my own software. That includes Daydrop, a complete internal leave and payroll system delivered for a working office, alongside games, graphics experiments and smaller utilities.
